evidence.claim: Microsoft says it collects and uses information depending on how you use its services, such as unique identifiers, how you interact with the services, content you upload and products you search for or buy.
Microsoft gives examples of using error reports to improve security, queries and clicks in Bing to improve search results, and voice data to improve speech recognition.
Microsoft says it adheres to self-regulatory advertising programs including the DAA in the US, EDAA in Europe and DAAC in Canada.
Microsoft gives an example that emptied Deleted Items remain in its system up to 30 days before final deletion unless legally required to be retained longer.
Microsoft says its collection depends on how you use each service and it uses data such as queries, clicks and error reports to improve products.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 16.16.6 (report dated Sept. 23, 2026) found code signatures for 9 known tracker SDK(s): Facebook Analytics (analytics), Facebook Login (identification), Facebook Share, GIPHY Analytics (analytics), Huawei Mobile Services (HMS) Core (analytics advertisement location), IAB Open Measurement (identification advertisement), Microsoft Visual Studio App Center Crashes (crash reporting), MixPanel (analytics), OneSignal. A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
